operatoren.definition: give the main features, structure or general principles of a topic omitting minor details
beispiele: Outline the author’s views on globalisation.

operatoren.definition: identify sth. and present it clearly
beispiele:
Point out the author's main ideas on child labour.
State the author's opinion on some of the benefits of globalisation.

operatoren.definition: (re)structure sth. and write it down
beispiele: Present the situation of the married woman described in the text.

operatoren.definition: give a concise account of the main points (condense)
beispiele: Summarize the information given in the text about climate change.

operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of what sth. is like
beispiele:
Describe the soldier’s outward appearance.
Describe the way in which the protagonist reacts to the news.

operatoren.definition: look at sth in detail and explain its meaning or structure
beispiele:
Analyse the main elements of the poster.
Examine the opposing views on class held by the two protagonists .

operatoren.operator: describe the character of/ give / write a characterization of
operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of the typical or most noticeable qualities or features of a person, place or thing
beispiele: Give a characterization of the mother in the story.

operatoren.definition: use examples to explain or make it clear
beispiele: Illustrate the way in which school life in Britain differs from that in Germany.

operatoren.definition: show similarities and differences
beispiele: Compare X’s and Y’s views on education.

operatoren.definition: show differences between two or more things
beispiele: Contrast the rights of African Americans in the 1960s and today.

operatoren.definition: make sth. clear by giving reasons and showing causes
beispiele: Explain the protagonist’s obsession with money.

operatoren.definition: analyse the form and content of sth. and establish its meaning in a wider context and give your own views on it
beispiele: Interpret the poem/cartoon.

operatoren.definition: establish a connection between two things
beispiele: Relate the cartoon to the short story.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion about the nature or quality of sb./sth. after careful consideration of the most important aspects in question
beispiele:
Assess the importance of learning languages for somebody’s future.
Evaluate the success of the steps taken so far to reduce the amount of household rubbish.

operatoren.definition: state clearly your opinions on the topic in question, giving evidence to support your view
beispiele: Comment on the thesis expressed in the text that the greenhouse effect is a good thing.

operatoren.definition: investigate an issue by argument; give reasons for and against
beispiele: Discuss the implications of globalization as presented in the text.

operatoren.definition: make understandable a decision/conclusion/view etc. by giving solid reasons
beispiele: You are the principal of a school. Justify your decision to forbid smoking on the school premises.

operatoren.definition: express your thoughts on sth. carefully and deeply
beispiele:
Reflect on the situation the main characters are in.
Reflect on your writing.

operatoren.definition: produce sth. that has not existed before
beispiele:
Create an ending of the Short Story.
Write a letter to the editor.

operatoren.definition: form a picture in your mind of what sth. might be like and give a detailed account of it
beispiele: Imagine you were the protagonist. Write his diary entry at the end of the day.
